scripts.build: pnpm --filter nano-ux run build && pnpm --filter website run build
scripts.lint: oxlint && biome check && pnpm -r run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter nano-ux run build && pnpm --filter demo run test
scripts.stop: for port in 9000 9001; do lsof -nP -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN | while read -r pid; do kill "$pid"; done; done
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter nano-ux run build && pnpm --filter website run dev
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter nano-ux run build && pnpm --parallel --filter nano-ux --filter demo run dev
